title: ztl mdBook preprocessor envelope v1
description: JSON shape exchanged with mdBook preprocessors per SPEC-033 REQ-3309 / CON-3309. Implements mdBook's own `[Context, Book]` protocol (CON-3304): the host writes a 2-element array to the preprocessor's stdin and reads back a `Book` on stdout. Version tracks the ztl adapter, not mdBook — the embedded `mdbook_version` field records which mdBook protocol version the envelope conforms to.

Context.description: mdBook preprocessor invocation context (first array element). Fields mirror mdBook's internal `PreprocessorContext` struct; ztl constructs synthetic values because there is no on-disk book.toml.

root.description: Absolute or vault-relative path to the book root. ztl passes the vault root.

preprocessor.description: Preprocessor-specific config block read from book.toml's `[preprocessor.<name>]` tables. ztl synthesises an empty object; preprocessors requiring custom config are currently unsupported (tracked in the compat matrix).

renderer.description: Renderer id the preprocessor is being invoked for. Defaults to `html`; options.renderer overrides when set.

mdbook_version.description: SemVer string acceptable to the preprocessor's compatibility check.

Book.description: mdBook `Book` envelope (second array element). A flat ordered list of sections plus the `__non_exhaustive` marker mdBook's own serde emits.

BookItem.description: One entry in `book.sections`. The envelope v1 emits only `Chapter` items; mdBook itself also supports `PartTitle` and `Separator`, which ztl does not produce and does not pattern-match when reading back preprocessor output.

content.description: Raw chapter Markdown; the field preprocessors rewrite.

number.description: Section number; ztl emits null (no auto-numbering) but mdBook-mermaid and similar may set it on the way back.

sub_items.description: Nested chapters. ztl emits an empty array for per-page scope; preprocessors like mdbook-toc may add entries on the way back.

path.description: Vault-relative chapter path; ztl uses `<slug>.md`. May be null for Draft chapters.
